Subject: Mutual Plan: 60-day evaluation & pilot timeline

Hi Sofia / Raj —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I’m putting a starting MAP in your inbox to align on stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic timeline to move from evaluation -> pilot. I attached a one-page mutual plan (mutual_plan_greenleaf_v1.pdf) and a small evaluation criteria sheet.

High-level proposal (please confirm):
- Week 0–2: kickoff & access – security questionnaire, sample data access (read-only), and SLA for test traffic.
- Week 3–4: demo + integration smoke-tests (Redwood provides sample SDK snippets and a small test harness).
- Week 5–8: evaluation period (workload runs, cost/latency monitoring, quality checks tied to the attached evaluation-criteria-sheet.xlsx).
- Week 9: pilot decision meeting and next-step SOW / Reserved capacity planning.

Primary goals we heard from you: reduce inference cost for clinical summarization by 40% and achieve median 95th percentile latency <= 180ms for 512-token requests. Please confirm these are still the right measurable goals or update as needed.

A couple of asks from our side so we can finalize the MAP:
1) Confirm champion and technical point-of-contact (we have Sofia listed as champion).
2) Share any required legal / procurement contacts for the pilot SOW.
3) Any non-standard security controls or data handling rules we should know about before we grant test access?

If that looks good I’ll circulate a calendar invite for the kickoff (30–45m) and share a lightweight playbook for the first two weeks.

Attachment: mutual_plan_greenleaf_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: evaluation-criteria-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

-Markus
